name: Bug Collector
text: You run into a bug collector. He offers to share with you one of the bugs he has caught today.

name: Dragons Nest
text: You stumble upon a dragon's hoard. Take something before the dragon comes back!

name: Rainbow Berry
text: As you wade through the forest, you stumble upon a berry bush. In the bush is a peculiar rainbow berry.

options.label: Feed it to a monster
notes: Target: A non-shiny Batomon with a shiny form

name: Traveling Merchant
text: You meet a traveling merchant. He offers you his strange wares.

options.label: Take the exotic monster
options.effect: Gain a foreign Rare monster. It can now appear in your shop.

name: Baby Basilisk
text: In the middle of a forest, you come across a crying baby basilisk monster. It seems it has gotten lost from its parents.

name: Fossil Discovery
text: You discover a winged fossil deep inside a cave.

options.label: Take it to a lab and revive it

name: Meteor Crash
text: You see a meteor fly through the sky and then crash nearby. You rush over to see the meteor with a glowing gem embed in it.

options.label: Take some meteor debris and sell it

name: Pond Fairy
text: As you stroll through the forest, a blue fairy monster emerges from a nearby pond. The fairy says it will grant you a wish.

name: Dragon Tamer
text: You run into a traveling dragon tamer. He says he has too many dragons to take care of and offers you to adopt one.

options.label: Adopt the one with the big horn
Adopt the one with the crown

name: Dryad Statue
text: You explore deep into the woods and find a statue with a glowing gem embedded in its head.

options.label: Pray to it
options.effect: Give a monster Grass typing, Gain Dryadell
notes: Target: A Batomon without Grass typing

name: Dryad Statue Oshima
text: You explore deep into the woods and find a statue with a glowing gem embedded in its head.

options.label: Pray to it
options.effect: Give a monster Grass typing, Gain Ginsage
notes: Target: A Batomon without Grass typing

name: Genius Inventor
text: You encounter a genius inventor. He asks if you want to test any of his new inventions.

options.label: Test the Recombobulator
options.effect: Randomly transform your monsters 1 rarity higher (max Mythical rarity)
notes: Resolves at the start of the next shop.

options.label: Test the Shockify Ray
options.effect: Give a monster Electric typing and +5 Shock
notes: Target: A Batomon without Electric typing

name: Professor Encounter
text: You run into a monster professor who's out doing research. He asks if there is anything you need help with?

name: Endless Boss Prep
text: You've finally made it this far. You might need one of these for the final battle

name: Second Chance
text: A mysterious trainer approaches. She says, "Don't give up now. You have potential. Take this."

options.label: Accept a life and a trinket
options.effect: Get a Super Rare trinket gift

options.label: Accept a life and a monster
options.effect: Gain a random level 2 Super Rare monster

options.label: Accept a life and a charm
